say:1:1130123001:1.text: I miss Pops so much. He used to put me on his shoulders so I could see far away.
say:1:1130123001:1.source_cn: 我很想老爹，以前老爹喜欢把我放在肩膀上，我可以看得很远。

say:2:1130123002:1.text: Pops was always busy. Soren and Alsa would run around trying to keep up with him.
say:2:1130123002:1.source_cn: 老爹总是很忙，，阿尔萨姐姐和索恩哥哥会跟在他身后跑来跑去。

say:3:1130123003:1.text: But every time I reached up for him, Pops would always toss me up on his shoulders...
say:3:1130123003:1.source_cn: 但每次，只要我伸手，老爹就会把我放在他的肩膀上……
